facts.value: State telecom operator managing fixed-line, DSL, VDSL, and fiber infrastructure across Lebanon. Handles landline faults, fixed internet outages, physical damage to telecom cabinets and cables, and low-speed complaints on OGERO infrastructure. Does NOT handle mobile network or billing issues for Alfa/Touch. Complaint domains encoded for routing: fixed_internet_outage, landline_fault, dsl_vdsl_issue, fiber_outage, telecom_cabinet_damage, telecom_cable_cut, slow_fixed_internet, new_line_request, service_unresponsive_ogero, infrastructure_damage.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: mobile_network_issues(Alfa_Touch); mobile_billing_disputes(TRA); satellite_internet; private_ISP_issues_beyond_last_mile; mobile_network_coverage_4g_5g_or_cellular_signal; Route instead to TRA_OR_MOBILE_OPERATOR when Do not route Alfa Touch or cellular coverage complaints to Ogero.; mobile_billing_roaming_or_operator_consumer_dispute; Route instead to TRA when Mobile billing/regulatory disputes go to operator then TRA escalation.; private_router_wifi_password_device_or_home_lan; Route instead to HITL_PRIVATE_CPE when Ask whether the Ogero line itself is affected before routing.; private_isp_reseller_satellite_or_non_ogero_service; Route instead to HITL_PRIVATE_ISP when Confirm provider and Ogero last-mile evidence before routing.; routine_fixed_internet_or_landline_technical_fault; Route instead to OGERO when Use Ogero first for fixed technical faults unless provider failure/regulatory dispute is described.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national. Route fixed-line internet and landline faults to Ogero when line or area is known. Ask for municipality exact location or line/account details before field routing. Route Ogero asset repair to Ogero and co-note municipality if public-space obstruction exists. Emergency services first if there is immediate danger then Ogero for telecom asset repair.
